block.createkineticlift.control_seat.too: When seated a _GUI will appear on your screen_ that gives you _information_.
You will sit on the seat and then your _keyboard/joystick_ will connect to the seat's sidestick, and lets you _control the plane_.
The seat will change into a _co-pilot_ variant.
block.createkineticlift.turbofan_front.t: Creates thrust up to _185 BPS_, and it's more efficient _20mB/s_.
For assembly you need to put _exhaust_ to make it work.
Connect it with _control seat_ to work.
item.createkineticlift.red_cable.tooltip: Connect the seat with Computer Cable.
R-Click the seat, and you have main _input_. R-Click other blocks, and you have an _output_!
